tracking: T44 via existing progress.py; not a second engine

cases.title: Independent original capture
cases.expected: Reference binary/version/hash and terminal profile resolved; independent upstream frames captured. No own-renderer expected substituted for original.

cases.title: Equivalent state and provenance
cases.expected: Paired scenario/fixture/profile hashes match. Different state or dimensions are INVALID, not PASS; supplied images used only as visual targets.

cases.title: Bare oc and route states
cases.expected: Actual bare oc opens TUI in TTY; non-TTY explicit error. Home/empty/populated/error states follow captured reference without mock fallback.

cases.title: Wide layout and sidebar
cases.expected: Original and oc paired wide frame has sidebar/title/context/location with correct geometry at >120 when enabled; no fixed 20-row viewport.

cases.title: Resize and viewport
cases.expected: 80x24,120x40,160x48 and widths43/44/119/120/121; >35-row transcript uses visible height, shrink/grow preserves cursor/scroll/draft.

cases.title: Data-driven chrome
cases.expected: Session title, model/provider display names, agent color, usage and known/unknown pricing come from actual DTOs, not renderer constants.

cases.title: Conditional devtools
cases.expected: Normal/reference production profile has matching debug bar visibility; hidden bar reserves no row; shown actions correspond to real capabilities.

cases.title: Command palette actual hotkey
cases.expected: Raw Ctrl+P opens overlay Commands with focused Search, categories, right shortcuts and no transcript reflow. Selected action really executes.

cases.title: Model dialog search and selection
cases.expected: Select model uses display metadata, current-dot vs focus, scrolling beyond8 rows, actual model/variant choice in captured provider request.

cases.title: Modal focus and backdrop
cases.expected: Cell styles reflect correct backdrop/surface, dimensions60/88/116 constrained by width; Esc restores draft/focus and does not quit app. In an existing multi-message session, hovering the user message changes only its block as upstream; mouse-up without selected text opens the matching Message Actions dialog, text selection does not. Jump to dismisses for the already visible message, Revert stages real undo of messages/file changes and refills the prompt, Copy requests a clipboard write with the exact message text (verify the destination separately where supported, per VIS27), Fork creates a real session before that user message with the prompt restored. Paired normal/hover/dialog styled-cell and PNG frames plus post-action session, file and clipboard evidence are required; missing owner actions cannot be represented by inert menu entries.

cases.title: Keyboard modifiers and events
cases.expected: Ctrl/Alt do not leak printable chars; Press/Repeat/Release rules tested, leader shortcuts correct per focus, no duplicate submission. In a real PTY, Ctrl+C clears a nonempty focused prompt without exiting or sending a provider request; Ctrl+C on an empty root prompt exits; in a modal it clears the focused search or dismisses the modal without exiting.

cases.title: Multiline Unicode editor
cases.expected: Raw newline/cursor/history/paste/edit sequence preserves graphemes, drafts, selection and single durable Enter acceptance.

cases.title: Markdown table fidelity
cases.expected: 2-column11-row Russian tool table rendered with reference borders/wrap/styles; escaped pipes, wide glyphs and long cells covered.

cases.title: Markdown streaming and code
cases.expected: Fences/headings/lists/inline spans match reference including incomplete stream; completed blocks not globally reparsed every frame.

cases.title: Reasoning and footer truth
cases.expected: Collapsed/running/complete/error reasoning and known duration/usage visible; opaque encrypted continuation absent from UI/logs. In a paired two-turn transcript, final assistant text, agent/model attribution, and the next user's message have the same blank/styled row positions as pinned upstream, including wrapped text and replay; the entire frame remains subject to pixel-parity comparison, not a cropped-region PASS.

cases.title: Tool cards and partial patch
cases.expected: Live real operation events create correctly ordered cards/hunks/error/unknown/truncation. Incomplete/partial patch is never displayed as full success. Eligible Explored groups and long-output Shell blocks match upstream normal/hover/click-expanded/second-click-recollapsed full styled-cell and PNG frames, including scroll and actual recorded output after reopen; hover only highlights. Ordinary Read does not falsely offer full-file expansion and an upstream/tool-truncated result is not presented as recoverable data.

cases.title: Durable replay parity
cases.expected: Same session parts/cards/metadata render equivalently after page reload, session switch and process restart, with one durable owner.

cases.title: Pending submit responsiveness
cases.expected: Stalled MCP initialize before accepted; actual PTY resize/cancel works within recorded bound, draft retained, no duplicate turn or orphan.

cases.title: MCP failure diagnostics
cases.expected: crw or faithful sanitized fixture exposes server+stage+safe cause; required failure not hidden; disabled zero spawn; exact auth/protocol per actual server.

cases.title: Source boundary
cases.expected: Discovered local .opencode symlink cannot admit external config; no outside content read/network before admission; explicit global root positive case.

cases.title: Control-sequence and secret safety
cases.expected: CSI/OSC/BEL and secrets in fake outputs do not become terminal actions or leak into reports; Unicode/text remain usable.

cases.title: Session and child integrity
cases.expected: Late events routed by request/turn/session/generation, permissions remain narrowed, subagent state genuine; Location switch does not import stale local state.

cases.title: Resource qualification after TUI change
cases.expected: Equal active context with growing archive measured on final real binary; styles/markdown caches/liveparts/queues bounded, not hidden by20 rows.

cases.title: Paired visual and final behavioral qualification
cases.expected: Session/Commands/Models paired cells+PNG exact under lock, all preceding cases accounted, fresh fmt/clippy/tests/build/PTY/golden and failed attempts retained; no premature READY.

cases.title: Slash autocomplete overlay
cases.expected: Typing / in the prompt opens an inline filtered list of built-in and current-generation workspace commands in both session and Home; Up/Ctrl+P and Down/Ctrl+N move the selection; Tab completes; Enter executes an argument-free built-in or inserts '/alias ' for an argument-taking/workspace command; Esc closes the list without discarding the draft; a space between trigger and cursor hides the list and an empty filter shows the no-match state. Paired original/native styled-cell/PNG frames for trigger, filtered query and after Tab.

cases.title: @ file mention overlay
cases.expected: Typing @ at line start or after a space with no spaces in the query opens a location-relative file list bounded to the admitted current-Location root (sorted, no absolute paths, no symlink/data-root escape); selection inserts a relative @path mention and submit reaches a real durable turn. Paired original/native styled-cell/PNG frames for trigger, filtered query and after Tab; skills/non-primary agent sections are deferred (T45) supported differences, not passed.

cases.title: Mouse selection and upstream clipboard feedback
cases.expected: Under the same terminal profile, original and native select mode: a mouse-up marked isDragging copies nonempty selected text, including word/line selection by repeated clicks without pointer movement; empty or ordinary non-drag release does not copy. Manual mode: right-button mouse-down copies an existing nonempty selection. Copy retains the highlight. A successful clipboard write shows the info toast 'Copied to clipboard'; failure does not show a success toast. Verify event/selection behavior and paired toast frames in PTY; separately verify the clipboard destination where supported. A toast frame alone does not prove that an external system clipboard received the text.

cases.title: Running agent indicator in lower-left prompt footer
cases.expected: In a real running session the lower-left footer, below agent/model metadata and before 'esc interrupt', shows the pinned eight-cell agent-colored blocks/trail scanner. With animations enabled, paired original/native temporal captures show forward motion, end hold, reverse motion and start hold at the nominal 40 ms frame cadence; compare matched phases, not unrelated wall-clock frames. With animations disabled both show '[⋯]' beside the interrupt hint. On completion or interruption the running indicator disappears. Metadata labels remain data-driven; a static spinner or an animation-off-only capture cannot pass this case.
